rules.rule: Use Moq argument matchers like It.IsAny<T>() consistently in setups.
rules.doNot: Never mix raw values and matchers in one Moq setup.

rules.trigger: creating API routes that use Prisma
rules.rule: Use a single shared PrismaClient instance across API routes.
rules.doNot: Never instantiate a new PrismaClient per request.

rules.rule: Use parameterized SQL queries for all user input.
rules.doNot: Never concatenate user input into SQL strings.

rules.rule: Use a Money value object holding amount and currency together.
rules.doNot: Never represent money as a bare decimal.

rules.rule: Store timestamps in UTC and format them as ISO 8601.
rules.doNot: Never store local time without an offset.

rules.rule: Use ConfigureAwait(false) on awaits in library code.
Hash passwords with a slow algorithm such as bcrypt.
rules.doNot: Never store passwords in plain text.

rules.rule: Redact secrets, tokens, and passwords from logs.
rules.doNot: Never log authorization headers or access tokens.

rules.rule: Give each rendered list item a stable key prop.
rules.doNot: Never use the array index as a React key for dynamic lists.

rules.rule: Return accurate HTTP status codes; use 404 for missing resources.
Use AsNoTracking() for read-only EF Core queries.
Guard public method arguments with ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull.
Set an explicit TTL and invalidation strategy for every cache.
